# SI003 — public-method-missing-annotations

Public methods must annotate every parameter and the return value.

## Why

Annotations are the source of the typed client and the contract schema. Missing annotations silently degrade codegen.

## Bad

```python
@gl.public.view
def get_incident(self, incident_id): ...
```

## Good

```python
@gl.public.view
def get_incident(self, incident_id: str) -> str: ...
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI003 -- reason
```
